members.name: banking_routing
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific customer request best describes what the message is about?

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a newly received card
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account / can children use it
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or a smartwatch with the account, including topping up or adding money via Apple Pay / Google Pay
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs can be used, ATM availability, how to use ATMs
criteria.automatic_top_up: Setting up or how auto top-up works
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Balance not updated after a bank transfer into the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Cash or cheque deposit not showing in balance
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary / payee not allowed
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they made
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring, getting a replacement for expiry
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted / will the card work at a merchant
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, shipping time
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app, adding a card to the account, or reactivating / putting back in the app a card that was lost and has since been found
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Asking why a fee was charged on a card payment or purchase, or why some payments have fees
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment to a merchant that the customer does not recognise or did not make
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card payment abroad
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for an ATM cash withdrawal
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal the customer did not make
criteria.change_pin: Changing an existing card PIN to a new one, where the PIN can be changed
criteria.compromised_card: Card details may be compromised / someone else used the card
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank serves: whether the customer can sign up, open an account or get a card while living in a given country, or whether the account works in other countries around the world
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment or purchase was declined / the card keeps getting declined at checkout
criteria.declined_transfer: A bank transfer to another account was declined (not a card purchase)
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Any problem with a direct debit: one the customer does not recognise, did not set up, or wants refunded or reversed
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits on disposable virtual cards, how many uses
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing name, address or other personal details
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rates are used, where they come from
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra amount on the statement: a small charge (e.g. 1 pound) the customer did not purchase, a charge made in error, or paying more than the set price
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies can be held or exchanged
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get a disposable virtual card
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting the physical card and its initial PIN: where to find or receive the PIN of a new card, when the PIN is set up, how to get the physical card
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an extra or additional card
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get a virtual card
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card is currently lost or stolen and needs reporting/blocking (not a card that has been found again)
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost, stolen or left somewhere, and access to the app without it
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot app passcode, can't log in
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment still showing as pending
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked after too many attempts
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money or get a salary paid into the account, including receiving it in another currency
criteria.refund_not_showing_up: A merchant refund has not appeared yet
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for a purchase
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment that was made was then cancelled, reverted or returned to the balance
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which card types or currencies are accepted for topping up or paying, including which currencies a top-up method such as Google Pay accepts
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or cheque
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on how much money can be added or topped up, including daily limits on the card or account
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a card
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Recipient did not receive a transfer
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity, documents needed
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification of a top-up / card verification code for top-up
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM dispensed wrong amount of cash
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate on a cash withdrawal abroad
